notes.title: COOP SURVIVAL TOWER DEFENSE - LET'S PLAY TOGETHER
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/2eedc8697538a05093136b37f6250015364998ea.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Guardians! [/b]

It's time, the Demo is up! Play Line Hold with your friends (or strangers) in [b]COOP [/b]mode or try to survive as long as you can by yourself!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/c634fb506c6f500494ce4c127a16344807a0c413.gif[/img]

Hop on our servers and show these muties what you are capable off! And no need to rush, as we said in our previous post, there is [b]no time restriction[/b] on this Demo. Play for as long as you like!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/e9076ff5407f453cc0843c70f0d9445ae620185d.gif[/img]


[h2]HOW TO PLAY WITH OTHERS[/h2]
Quick info how to play with others:
[list]
    [*]In main menu select [b]Host Game[/b] or [b]Join Game[/b]
    [*]While hosting you will be able to choose the map and wait for players or start early
    [*]While joining select any game from the listed games
    [*]You can join to other players at any time during the game
    [*]Each map can be played by up to 4 players
[/list]


[h2]HOW TO CONTACT US[/h2]
If you will be having any questions, problems or feedback for us please contact us in any of these places:
[list]
    [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1537590/discussions/]Steam Forum[/url]
    [*][url=https://discord.gg/fu2QhfKyRc]Discord Server![/url]
    [*]And in the comments here
[/list]


Enjoy our demo and bring some friends to experience the [b]COOP[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1537590/LineHold

Best Regards,
Line Hold Dev Team

notes.title: Progress Update - HUB Overview
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/4e3ec4b81d00b9761b99cfaa575695fe20d85205.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Guardians! [/b]

Let's take a look at the [b]HUB Area[/b]! You will be able to visit it between missions to test new weapons, turrets, discovered enemies and more.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/aadbfe53251558a225c930f92cea3912862442ed.gif[/img]


In the central part of the HUB is the [b]command center[/b] where you can [b]select available missions[/b] (which will be added as the game is being developed).
You will be able to select your starting gear; meaning weapons and available buildings.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/802cc9193d06da599cc500bb552b428842ab9dfd.gif[/img]


In the [b]Laboratory [/b]you will be able to tweak your [b]Perk Tree[/b] (described in more detail in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1537590/announcements/detail/3634998253144469347]previous post[/url]) and also see some [b]info about discovered enemies[/b].

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/2c9eba333f88f2eb35b090a5ea5e05f721c853e3.gif[/img]


In [b]Mech Bay [/b]you will be able to see all unlocked turrets and test their abilities in safe environment - also more details in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1537590/announcements/detail/5281067109622006202]previous post[/url].

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/51bfef29b1fb43f69cda0c9ee55ef9c83d6890ba.gif[/img]


And last but not least - Shooting Range; here you will be able to test out your gear. Shoot away, the ammo is on the house! Read [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1537590/announcements/detail/3640628950015654539]this post[/url] to see examples of some weapons in Line Hold


[h2]WHAT ELSE?[/h2]
Focusing mostly on multiplayer features and survival maps. We will have some [b]exciting news[/b] in the next post so stay tuned!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1537590/LineHold

Best Regards,
Line Hold Dev Team

notes.title: Progress Update - Turrets and Mech Bay
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/a0b3686831cfbf76a49b20ee82bbae199ba9a80f.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Guardians! [/b]

It's Friday 13th so why won't you use some [b]turrets [/b]to protect yourself!


Today we take a look at three turrets in Line Hold and how they work. Also we will take a quick peek at [b]Mech Bay in Hub[/b] area.

There are [b]Double Bolt Turrets[/b] that shoot nearest enemy - high fire rate and bullets have a small [b]knockback [/b]effect that is very effective against lighter enemies.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/4523b1cca9094536fe9fa22eef1aef0bc48b9436.gif[/img]

[b]Thumer Towers[/b] damage all enemies nearby - making them very useful in chokepoints and against swarms of smaller enemies.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/819b008d5ad6fe6c3328727ef8ff69b37bb00daa.gif[/img]

[b]Laser focus[/b] turrets target a single enemy. The longer they stay on one target - the more damage they deal over time, making them perfect for more tanky enemies.
And as you can see - there will be dedicated part of the Hub called [b]Mech Bay[/b] that will help you test out different turrets.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/114421f0f2f6b95d620f17d5d5c2550bcbc94a60.gif[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/2654aeabcae4bd34c74577da0b098806aafe5169.png[/img]

It will be possible to set [b]target priority [/b]for all turrets to make sure to maximize their effectiveness. 

[h2]WHAT ELSE?[/h2]
Getting ready for updating visuals of the game and testing multiplayer.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1537590/LineHold]Add Line Hold to your Wishlist![/url][/b] & stay tuned for our the next update!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1537590/LineHold

Best Regards,
Line Hold Dev Team

notes.title: Progress Update - Shooting Range and some Weapons
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/29388abc08e52b606b2dc0e65b6ebc67e019eb4c.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Guardians! [/b]

Let's take a look at the [b]Shooting Range[/b] in your [b]Hub [/b]area!

You will be able to try out different weapons in the hub between the missions to get a better feel for them.
For example practice trickshots with the Cutter

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/0a736d6b3313f25df5b452455a580a4978daf097.gif[/img]

Each weapon will have [b]two firing modes[/b] - primary fire mode and secondary fire mode.
Some of the firing modes will have [b]synergies [/b]- like plasma rifle that will amplify the explosion range of secondary fire mode when hit with the default projectile.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/ea703bdc85a5e69ad535218b119f8e0571f6f2bc.gif[/img]

You will be able to easily switch betwen currently held weapon and the weapon on your back - chose weapons that will fit your playstyle best.
Also [b]switch weapons instantly reloads[/b] the weapon on your back.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/59959a068d05353b951b79e14d8d50cc59d41d55.gif[/img]


[h2]WHAT ELSE?[/h2]
Improving the visuals of the game and making sure that gameplay mechanics will work fine on recently announced multiplayer

notes.title: Progress Update - MULTIPLAYER!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/3928354ad89f537a26605d33b36a59648db99f92.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Guardians! [/b]

Today we announce [b]multiplayer[/b]! After all, it's Christmas season, so connect with other people!

It will be possible to play Line Hold up to [b]4 players[/b]! Each one of you can pick different class or the same one, it's up to you.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/37e20488bc5cbfe366844a03ae7e27f80764b2b6.gif[/img]

Every player will have [b]their own resources[/b] (money, ammunition and blocker segments) that they can share with other player. [b]And everybody will be able to place the buildings[/b] in the Building Phase.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/e2c73a7bdb23f83e8fa089a11213a4d546105b14.gif[/img]

As long as at least one player stays alive in survival mode, all of you come back after the enemy wave is defeated.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/2ba8219708d5ebff188cd248096d359001734e22.gif[/img]


[h2]WHAT ELSE?[/h2]
We are still improving the graphics and generally polishing the look of the game. Adding multiplayer means a lot of changes for the mechanics and the balance.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1537590/LineHold]Add Line Hold to your Wishlist![/url][/b] & stay tuned for our the next update!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1537590/LineHold

Best Regards,
Line Hold Dev Team

notes.title: Progress Update - Perk Tree
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/07ffa9b0a5cfae9dad6716d8c92ee62a3a9bb2ab.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Guardians! [/b]

Today we take a sneak peek at [b]perk trees[/b] and how they work for playable characters!

(By the way, you can read more about playable classes in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1537590/view/5349741308801547347]previous posts[/url])

Each class will have their [b]unique perk tree[/b]. Additionally each perk tree will have [b]four paths[/b] that can help you specialize in your preferred playstyle.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/b8c05411a9cc628f76a02be8f2aee2e1a0bdb2f2.gif[/img]

It's up to you to pick perks that will suit you best, you can mix different paths or commit to one of them to get the most powerful perks.

Perks can be changed at your leisure when you are in the hub area between the missions - so you can always [b]adjust your perks[/b] before starting next battle.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/2f7e8ac0aac22623234deec0b449f9a15498acee.png[/img]

Perks can increase your base statistics but also can have passive effects - such as [b]setting nearby enemies on fire[/b] when your switching your weapon.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/400212521e6a9f0cea17d662add4bed95fd0c2e8.gif[/img]

As you level up, you will get more perk points - each class levels up separately as you play them so there will be plenty of playstyles for you to chose from.

[h2]WHAT ELSE?[/h2]
Other than playable characters we are working on updating graphics and implementing many mechanics that you will see in next posts.

[b]Add Line Hold to your Wishlist![/b]

Stay tuned for our the next update!


Best Regards,
Line Hold Dev Team

notes.title: Developer Update - Player Classes (part 2)
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/4c5d9571d38332c20ad8faea07921b6a6d06868e.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Guardians![/b]

Last time we introduced you to two playable characters - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1537590/view/5349741308801547347]Mech Mender and Frontliner[/url].
Just as a short reminder, each class will have their own speciality and their dedicated [b]perk tree[/b] along with [b]active skills[/b].

Today we will take a closer look at Phaser.


[h2]PHASER[/h2]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/fe341acec62c01eb9a79e99732669ade6eba5a10.gif[/img]

Phaser is a great class for quick "hit-and-run" tactics that can either sap away enemies' health or distract them from attacking crucial structures in the base. He is also great at eliminating enemies that are hiding in the back.

[list]
    [*]Phase Through Objects
    [*]High Stamina
    [*]Very Fast Movement
    [*]Great At Collecting Pickables
[/list]


His active ability is to phase through solid objects, including enemies. Can not shoot while in this state.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/56b6b19dc4635c082d0e4cd0f8927ae675d01fc9.gif[/img]


[h2]WHAT ELSE?[/h2]
Other than playable characters we are working on many mechanics that you will see in next posts as well as improving game visuals.

Stay tuned for our the next update where we will take a look at last playable character and see how perk trees work!


Best Regards,
Line Hold Dev Team

notes.title: Progress Update - Player Classes (part 1)
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/7299754842e353e53cc854b26fb81b99f5200bf7.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Guardians! [/b]

This is first part of the introduction to the playable characters in Line Hold!

There will be [b]4 playable characters[/b] in the game. In short, each class will have their own speciality and their dedicated [b]perk tree[/b] along with [b]active skills[/b].
Today we will take a closer look at two of them, Machine Mender and Frontliner.


[h2]MACHINE MENDER[/h2]

Machine Mender is a technological specialists that's more of a machine than a human at this point. 
Extremely useful when defending well fortified positions. She can repair nearby structures just by standing next to them in the heat of the battle. 

[list]
    [*]Boosting Machinery
    [*]Effortless Repairs
    [*]Chaining Together Turrets
    [*]Chokepoint Defense Expert
[/list]

Her active skill is chaining together nearby turrets which boosts their damage and durability for limited time.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/c27776214facf6197350b9924c818b76552cc3df.gif[/img]

[h2]FRONTLINER[/h2]

Frontliner is a grizzled veteran that can hold off the enemies of for a long time. The more enemies are nearby, the more damage he can deal
[list]
    [*]Corpse Explosion
    [*]Second WInd
    [*]Extreme Durability
    [*]Great Firepower
[/list]

His active ability is exploding corpses of the fallen enemies, making even more carnage.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40059448/f7a53f5cbc0400e8c07bd0a747fb88725c9e1e1d.gif[/img]

Disclaimer that this is still work in progress and not the final graphics that will be in released game.


[h2]WHAT ELSE?[/h2]
Other than playable characters we are working on updating graphics and implementing many mechanics that you will see in next posts.

Stay tuned for our the next update where we will introduce another playable character!

[url=https://discord.gg/fu2QhfKyRc]Join our Discord server![/url]


Best Regards,
Line Hold Dev Team
